# Amazon (5 endpoints)

## Endpoints

| Resource | Params | Credits | Description |
|----------|--------|---------|-------------|
| /shop | `url` | 1 | Get Amazon shop page |
| /product-search | `query` | 1 | Search Amazon products by keyword |
| /product | `asin` | 5 | Get an Amazon product by ASIN |
| /reviews | `asin` | 5 | Get Amazon product reviews |
| /sellers | `asin` | 1 | Get Amazon sellers and offers for a product |

### Parameter legend

- `a`, `b` — both required.
- `a` / `b` — a `oneOf` group: at least one member must be provided.
- *(none)* — no required parameters.

## Parameter Details

- `url`: Full URL of the Amazon shop or storefront page
- `query`: Search keyword or phrase.
- `country` *(optional, enum: US | GB | CA | DE | FR | IT | ES | JP | IN | MX | BR | AU | NL)*: Amazon marketplace as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (default US). Supported: US, GB, CA, DE, FR, IT, ES, JP, IN, MX, BR, AU, NL.
- `depth` *(optional, integer)*: Maximum number of products to return (max 700). Higher depth returns more rows at the same flat credit cost.
- `asin`: 10-character Amazon ASIN (the product identifier).

## Example

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/amazon/shop?url=https://www.amazon.com/shop/sydneydelrey" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
